description: A unilateral posterior chain exercise targeting glutes and hamstrings while developing hip level balance.
setup: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, then lift one leg straight into the air.
steps: Press down firmly through the working heel on the floor.
Drive your hips upward until your knee, hip, and shoulder form a straight line.
Squeeze the working glute hard at the peak for a one-second pause.
Lower your hips under control back to the floor.
cues: Push through the heel rather than toes of the planted foot
Keep both hip bones level and parallel to the ceiling at the top

mistakes.mistake: Letting non-working hip drop or rotate down
mistakes.fix: Brace core and keep both hip points evenly elevated

mistakes.mistake: Overarching lower back instead of squeezing glutes
mistakes.fix: Stop when hip forms a straight diagonal line with ribcage pulled down

rep_standard: Begins with hips touching the floor, extends working hip until fully straight alignment with shoulders, and lowers back down.
